title: Already processing eth_requestAccounts
summary: Wallet returned: Already processing eth_requestAccounts.
likelyCauses: The user, wallet UI, or wallet request queue rejected the operation.
nextSteps: Do not auto-retry; let the user intentionally retry after reviewing the prompt.

likelyCauses: Connection state and UI state are out of sync.
nextSteps: Read the current connector/account state before dispatching another connect request.
title: Wallet connector already connected
summary: The app tried to open a wallet connection that is already active.

likelyCauses: The user is disconnected, the session expired, or app state assumes a connector is still active.
nextSteps: Require an active account before sending/signing and refresh connector state after page reloads.
title: Wallet connector not connected
summary: The app attempted a wallet action before the connector had an active account/session.

nextSteps: Offer WalletConnect/embedded wallet fallback and initialize injected connectors after the page has loaded.
